decision: REJECTED for deployment: the complete package timed out (>300s), so A-GR1 cannot land on a complete root as implemented. Its score is not refuted - the side-isolation reading (+29 over the v195 side baseline, third-largest official Attention mechanism gain after C76.4 +84 and A1 +60) stands, and the expressivity gradient (diagonal 0 < triangular 0 < symmetric +22 < general +29) remains officially confirmed. What is now priced is the cost: A-GR1's extra time is calibration-side training (6 layers x 32 Adam steps; the deployed dynamic path adds nothing), which is a property of the mechanism, not of the Linear parent. With a parent at 292s and only 8s of headroom, the side-measured +20.7s could not fit. Closes this implementation only; no step/window shrinking and no candidate-count reduction as a retry. Root unchanged (v231, 18518/291s). See logs/execution/2026-09-10-v234-agr1-side-official.md and logs/execution/2026-09-10-v234-agr1-official-timeout.md.
